name: Lord of the Cloister
text: When this fighter is recruited, pick 2 skills for them.

name: Master of Dark Spellcraft
text: This fighter knows the **Lore of Blessed Maggots**. When they are recruited, pick 2 spells from it to be their signature spells. In addition, at the start of each battle they prepare 1 random spell from it.

name: Dark Spellcraft
text: This fighter knows the **Lore of Blessed Maggots**. When they are recruited, pick 1 spell from it to be their signature spell. In addition, at the start of each battle they prepare 1 random spell from it.

name: Lord of the Cloister
text: When this fighter is recruited, pick 1 skill for them.

name: Darkcloven Magic
text: This fighter knows the **Lore of Blessed Maggots** and the **Demonic Lore of Rot**. However, when they are recruited they have no signature spells. At the start of each battle they prepare 1 random spell from each lore.

name: Ram Horns
text: After this fighter finishes a Charge Move, pick 1 enemy fighter engaged in melee with them to be the target. The target is hit by 2 attacks as follows: Rend -1, Damage 1.

name: Demonic Spellcraft
text: This fighter knows the **Demonic Lore of Rot**. When they are recruited, pick 1 spell from it to be their signature spell. In addition, at the start of each battle they prepare 1 random spell from it.

name: Demonic Wards
text: This fighter ignores Rend when making armour rolls.

name: Fear
text:
This fighter *causes fear*. Enemy fighters that start their activation engaged in melee with a fighter that causes fear must pass a Willpower test. If they fail, their activation immediately ends.

Enemy fighters that also cause fear can ignore this rule.
